name: Common
content: The language Common (Standard) is spoken by Humans and is identified by the script also named Common. It can be found at the url /api/languages/common.

name: Dwarvish
desc: Dwarvish is full of hard consonants and guttural sounds.
content: Dwarvish (Dwarvish) is a Standard language spoken primarily by Dwarves, known for its hard consonants and guttural sounds. This language is characterized by its robust phonetic structure and is commonly used in communication among Dwarven communities. Learning Dwarvish can be beneficial for those interested in understanding Dwarven culture and history, as well as for individuals looking to forge alliances or trade relationships with Dwarven societies.

name: Elvish
desc: Elvish is fluid, with subtle intonations and intricate grammar. Elven literature is rich and varied, and their songs and poems are famous among other races. Many bards learn their language so they can add Elvish ballads to their repertoires.
content: Elvish (Standard) is a graceful language spoken primarily by Elves, known for its fluidity, subtle intonations, and intricate grammar. Elven literature, including songs and poems, is renowned among various races, inspiring many bards to learn the language for their repertoires. The script used for writing Elvish is also called Elvish.

name: Giant
content: The Giant language is a Standard language spoken by Ogres and Giants, with its script written in Dwarvish. The index of this language is "giant" and its unique identifier is "65f4e07dafbcc38c5934421a".

name: Gnomish
desc: The Gnomish language, which uses the Dwarvish script, is renowned for its technical treatises and its catalogs of knowledge about the natural world.
content: Gnomish language is a standard dialect spoken primarily by Gnomes, utilizing the Dwarvish script. Known for its technical treatises and extensive knowledge of the natural world, Gnomish is a valuable asset for those seeking in-depth information and research capabilities.

name: Goblin
content: The Goblin is a Standard type creature often spoken by Goblinoids, with a script written in Dwarvish. It can be found under the index "goblin" and its unique identifier is "65f4e07dafbcc38c5934421c".

name: Halfling
desc: The Halfling language isn't secret, but halflings are loath to share it with others. They write very little, so they don't have a rich body of literature. Their oral tradition, however, is very strong.
content: The Halfling language, spoken by Halflings, is not widely shared with others due to their secretive nature. While they have a strong oral tradition, their written literature is limited. Halfling is classified as a Standard language with a script in Common.

name: Orc
desc: Orc is a harsh, grating language with hard consonants. It has no script of its own but is written in the Dwarvish script.
content: The Orc language is a harsh and grating tongue spoken primarily by Orcs. It lacks its own script and instead uses the Dwarvish script for written communication. Known for its hard consonants, Orc is considered a Standard language among its speakers. Understanding Orc can be beneficial for those looking to communicate with Orcs or delve into their culture.

name: Abyssal
content: The Abyssal language, also known as the Infernal script, is an Exotic tongue primarily spoken by Demons. It is often associated with dark and sinister entities, making it a valuable skill for those delving into the occult or demonic realms. The Abyssal language is characterized by its eerie and guttural sounds, with its origins shrouded in mystery and darkness.

name: Celestial
content: Celestial (Exotic) language, commonly spoken by Celestials, is represented by the "Celestial" script. It falls under the "celestial" index and is identified by the unique ID "65f4e07dafbcc38c59344220". This language is known for its connection to divine beings and is often associated with celestial knowledge and communication with higher powers.

name: Draconic
desc: Draconic is thought to be one of the oldest languages and is often used in the study of magic. The language sounds harsh to most other creatures and includes numerous hard consonants and sibilants.
content: The Draconic language, known for its harsh sounds and use in magic, is considered one of the oldest languages. It is classified as an Exotic language and is typically spoken by Dragons and Dragonborn. The script used for writing Draconic is also called Draconic.

name: Deep Speech
content: Deep Speech is an Exotic language spoken by Aboleths and Cloakers. It is known for its mystical and enigmatic nature, making it a rare and intriguing form of communication. You can learn more about Deep Speech by visiting the url /api/languages/deep-speech.

name: Primordial
content: Primordial (Exotic) is a language spoken by Elementals, with its script written in Dwarvish. This language is classified under the index "primordial" and can be found at the url "/api/languages/primordial".

name: Sylvan
content: Sylvan is an Exotic language spoken by Fey creatures, known for its script in Elvish. It is characterized by its mystical associations and is often used in communication with nature spirits and other magical beings. Learning Sylvan may enhance one's connection to the natural world and unlock hidden knowledge about the Fey realms.

name: Undercommon
content: Undercommon (Exotic) is a language spoken by Underdark traders, with its script written in Elvish. This language is known for its unique dialect and is often used for secretive communication among the underground community. Learning Undercommon can be advantageous for those seeking to navigate the intricate networks of the Underdark and interact with its denizens.

name: Infernal
content: The language Infernal is an Exotic language primarily spoken by Devils. It is written in the Infernal script and can be accessed through the url /api/languages/infernal.
